answer: Trust is delegated in chains, and any link can revoke the chain below it. Revocation is published immediately and checked at every use. The mirror signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm's chain breaks when one honest link revokes it, so 107 aliases need 107 unbroken chains. The delta ledger records each payment, the haven window resets the board, and 107 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
